name: jcrt
description: Journal for Cultural and Religious Theory: A Whitestone Foundation Publication

scripts.start: npm run sitemaps:generate && cross-env ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=serve NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 eleventy --serve
scripts.sequoia:publish:dry: npm run sequoia:stage && npx -y sequoia-cli publish --dry-run
scripts.sequoia:publish: npm run sequoia:stage && npm run sequoia:publication && npx -y sequoia-cli publish && node scripts/apply-sequoia-records.mjs && npm run atproto:frontmatter
scripts.sequoia:sync: npm run sequoia:stage && npx -y sequoia-cli sync --update-frontmatter && node scripts/apply-sequoia-records.mjs && npm run atproto:frontmatter
scripts.check:redirects:all: npm run check:redirects && npm run check:redirects:deployed
scripts.css:purge: purgecss --css _site/css/bs.css --content "_site/**/*.html" --output _site/css/ --safelist show showing collapsing collapse modal-backdrop fade offcanvas-backdrop
scripts.build:local: cross-env LOCAL_BUILD=1 FAST_BUILD=1 LEAN_BUILD=1 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=serve NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 eleventy --incremental --quiet && npm run check:icons
scripts.build:latest: cross-env USE_LATEST_ISSUE=1 FAST_BUILD=1 LEAN_BUILD=1 SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 eleventy --quiet
scripts.build:local:latest: cross-env USE_LATEST_ISSUE=1 LOCAL_BUILD=1 FAST_BUILD=1 LEAN_BUILD=1 SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=serve NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 eleventy --incremental --quiet
scripts.build:bench: cross-env BENCH_11TY=1 BENCH_ISSUE=24.2 FAST_BUILD=1 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=serve NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 eleventy --quiet
scripts.build: npm run sequoia:stage && npm run sitemaps:generate && npm run standard:check && rm -rf _site && cross-env SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy && npm run sitemaps:check && npm run oai:validate && npm run css:purge && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node _config/run-pagefind.js
scripts.build:netlify:full: npm run nanoids:check && npm run sitemaps:generate && npm run standard:check && rm -rf _site && echo "[build:netlify 1/4] Eleventy" && cross-env SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy --quiet && echo "[build:netlify 2/4] Sitemap checks" && npm run sitemaps:check && echo "[build:netlify 3/4] OAI validation (quick)" && npm run oai:validate:quick && echo "[build:netlify 4/4] Pagefind" && npm run css:purge && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node _config/run-pagefind.js
scripts.build:netlify:content: npm run nanoids:check && npm run sitemaps:generate && rm -rf _site && echo "[build:netlify content 1/3] Eleventy" && cross-env FAST_BUILD=1 SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy --quiet && echo "[build:netlify content 2/3] PurgeCSS" && npm run css:purge && echo "[build:netlify content 3/3] Pagefind" && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node _config/run-pagefind.js
scripts.build:netlify:fast: npm run nanoids:check && npm run sitemaps:generate && rm -rf _site && echo "[build:netlify fast 1/2] Eleventy" && cross-env FAST_BUILD=1 LEAN_BUILD=1 SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy --quiet && echo "[build:netlify fast 2/2] PurgeCSS" && npm run css:purge
scripts.build:fast: rm -rf _site && cross-env SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy --incremental && npm run css:purge && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node _config/run-pagefind.js
scripts.perf:benchmark:lean: cross-env DEBUG=Eleventy:*Benchmark* FAST_BUILD=1 LEAN_BUILD=1 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy
